system.description:
Barbarians who learned the discipline of the shield wall and the weight of mail, and carry their fury into armour.

  • Armoured Fury: you are trained in heavy armour, and Primeval Instincts and the wilderness abilities work in medium armour. While you rage in medium or heavy armour, the first attack against you each round has Disadvantage.
    • 9th level: while you rage in armour, you also have Advantage on saves and contests against being knocked Prone or pushed.
  • Shield-Wall Veteran: Advantage on Charisma checks with soldiers, mercenaries and watchmen, and you are recognised as a veteran on sight.
